en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of the Los Angeles River in flood after heavy rains. The river is wide and fast-flowing, contained by rough embankments with scattered people standing on the banks watching the water. On the left side, a group of people gathers near a wooden structure or bridge. Utility poles line the river, and a low bridge is visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears in red at the top, with additional handwritten ink notes on the upper right.
